run_eval_generation_with_text: run LAMA eval_generation on a piece of text using the --text flag with a language model
run_eval_generation_interactive: run LAMA eval_generation interactively using the --interactive flag to insert text at the prompt
run_eval_generation_with_sentence_split: run LAMA eval_generation with sentence splitting enabled using the --split_sentence flag and spacy
run_eval_generation_with_vocab_filter: run LAMA eval_generation with a common vocabulary filter using the --common-vocab-filename flag
run_eval_generation_multiple_models: run LAMA eval_generation with multiple language models using the --language-models comma-separated list
